mapper.sql: id, code, type, product_id, specification_id, supplier_id, purchase_id, purchase_item_id, location_id, customer_id, total_number, enter_number, remark, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.select:
select MIN(syso.id) as id, syso.purchase_id as purchaseId, syso.specification_id as specificationId, (select description from pro_yt_product_specification where id=syso.specification_id) as specificationDesc, syso.location_id as locationId, pypi.category_specification_item_id as labelId, SUM(syso.total_number) as totalNumber, SUM(syso.enter_number) as enterNumber, GROUP_CONCAT(syso.id) as storeOrderIdList, pyp.code as purchaseCode, pyp.remark as purchaseRemark, MAX(pypi.remark) as purchaseItemRemark, (select code from pro_yt_product where id=syso.product_id) as productCode, (select name from pur_yt_supplier where id=syso.supplier_id) as supplierName, (select name from sto_yt_location where id=syso.location_id) as locationName, pypi.category_specification_item_name as labelName from sto_yt_store_order as syso left join pur_yt_purchase as pyp on pyp.id = syso.purchase_id left join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on pypi.id = syso.purchase_item_id left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on pypi.order_sub_item_id=syosi.id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id left join sal_yt_customer_store as sycs on sycs.customer_id = syso.customer_id -- 关联客户ID and sycs.specification_id = syso.specification_id -- 关联规格ID and sycs.is_deleted = 0 -- 未删除 and sycs.status = 1 -- 有效状态 where syso.is_deleted = 0
AND syso.id IN
#{id}
AND pyp.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{purchaseCode}, '%')
AND syo.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderCode}, '%')
AND syso.specification_id = #{specificationId}
AND syso.customer_id = #{customerId}
AND syso.create_time >= #{startTime}
AND #{endTime} >= syso.create_time
AND (select name from pur_yt_supplier where id=syso.supplier_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
AND (select code from pro_yt_product where id=syso.product_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND syso.specification_id IN ( select psi.product_specification_id from pro_yt_product_specification_item psi where psi.category_specification_item_id in (select id from pro_yt_category_specification_item where value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{specificationName}, '%')) )
group by syso.purchase_id, syso.specification_id, syso.location_id, pypi.category_specification_item_id, pypi.category_specification_item_name, syso.product_id, syso.supplier_id,sycs.id
having
-- 过滤掉totalNumber=enterNumber（已全量入库），只保留未完成入库的数据 SUM(syso.total_number) != SUM(syso.enter_number)
-- 过滤掉totalNumber!=enterNumber（未全量入库），只保留已完成入库的数据 SUM(syso.total_number) = SUM(syso.enter_number)
order by max(syso.create_time) desc
select * from sto_yt_store_order as syso where syso.purchase_item_id =#{purchaseItemId} and syso.is_deleted=0

select syo.code as orderCode, LEAST( GREATEST(syso.enter_number, 0), LEAST(COALESCE(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) ) as enter_number , LEAST(COALESCE(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) as totalNumber from sto_yt_store_order as syso left join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on syso.purchase_item_id = pypi.id left join pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap on pap.id = pypi.apply_purchase_id left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.id = pypi.order_sub_item_id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id where syso.is_deleted=0 and pypi.is_deleted=0 and syosi.is_deleted=0 and syso.id = #{storeOrderId} and syosi.status < 4 and syosi.status >= 1 and LEAST(COALESCE(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) > 0
